records.field: 月部 entry; printed p. 618; PDF p. 631; original scan visually inspected
records.text: The entry describes 月 as a pictograph whose early form resembles a half moon, with ‘moon’ as its meaning. It says 月 and 夕 were sometimes confused, bronze forms continued the earlier line, and the small-seal form underwent graphic change. It cites an oracle-bone eclipse passage as 《合集》11485, then explains the calendar-month use through the moon’s waxing and waning and mentions a later ‘time’ sense. The entry and its discussion are visible on this page; the next page begins with the following headword 朔, so no continuation of 月 is indicated.
